settings.heading: BEFORE YOU LIGHT
settings.lede: A few essentials for a safe and simple incense experience.

settings.label: Light
settings.image_alt: Incense stick resting in a black holder

settings.label: Let it catch
settings.text: Let the tip burn, then blow out the flame. Ensure it glows and releases a steady stream of smoke.

settings.label: Place in the holder
settings.image_alt: Smoking incense stick placed in a black holder

settings.label: Put it out

settings.heading: HOW TO BURN INCENSE
settings.lede: Follow these simple steps to light, enjoy, and safely extinguish your incense.

settings.heading: Supervision
settings.text: Never leave burning incense unattended. Always keep it within sight.

settings.heading: Ventilation
settings.text: Always burn incense in a well-ventilated area to allow proper airflow.

settings.heading: Pets and children
settings.text: Keep burning incense away from children and pets.

settings.heading: Placement
settings.text: Keep burning incense away from curtains and other flammable materials.

settings.heading: BURN WITH CARE
settings.lede: A few essential safety precautions to keep in mind while your incense burns, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience.
settings.image_alt: Hand in a wool sleeve lighting a stick in a black holder, a Yoga Studio box lying on the walnut table

settings.heading: LET IT COOL
settings.text: Let the incense stick and ash cool completely before touching or removing anything.

settings.heading: DISPOSE OF ASH
settings.text: Once completely cool, dispose of the ash and any remaining incense safely.

settings.heading: HOLDER CARE
settings.text: Remove leftover residue and clean your holder according to its material and care instructions.

settings.heading: WHEN THE SMOKE CLEARS
settings.lede: A few easy steps to safely clean up after your incense burns.
settings.image_alt: Ash and a spent stick in a black holder
